drhp.business: The Company is engaged in multi-brand retail selling of smartphones and allied accessories and also engaged in multi-brand retail selling of consumer durable electronics goods like Smart TVs, Air Conditioners, Fridges, Coolers etc. It offers a wide range of smartphones and mobile accessories from industry-leading brands including Apple, Samsung, Oppo, Realme, Vivo, Xiaomi and OnePlus, and has broadened into consumer durables from brands such as TCL, Haier, Daikin, Voltas, Mi and Realme.
drhp.end_markets: India retail (mobile phones, accessories, consumer durable electronics)
drhp.expansion: The Company is opening new retail stores in Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, New Delhi, Haryana, Rajasthan, Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh and Punjab in a phased manner, considering factors like customer base, political stability, government rules and regulations, standard of living, market outlook, and logistic & transportation convenience. The Company operates its retail stores under the brand names KORE and EROK for mobile phones, related accessories, consumer durable electronics, IT products and other electronic goods. Looking ahead, the Company is also adopting an asset-light model through the franchisee model, diversifying into higher-margin electronic products, and developing larger format stores of 2,000 square feet or more.

litigation.note: No significant and material orders passed by the regulators/courts/tribunals which would impact the going concern status of the Company and its future operations (Board's Report).

sk.overview: India's organised retail comprises organised brick-and-mortar and e-commerce, with e-commerce the fastest-growing format. India retail was ~Rs 83 trillion in FY2025 (~21% organised) and is projected to reach Rs 123-135 trillion by FY2030. India e-commerce (including quick commerce) is ~Rs 6 trillion GMV (~US$70 billion) currently, projected to reach Rs 15-18 trillion (12-13% retail penetration) by FY2030. demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- Revenue growth attributed to rise in sales volume of existing retail stores.
- Company's growth is linked to the overall economic trend, technology upgradation, inflation trends, disposable income of customers and competition from local and well-established players.
- Rising temperatures are catalyzing the Refrigeration and Air Conditioning (RAC) market.
- Low penetration rates across various segments present growth opportunities and a runway for first-time buyer brand loyalty.
- Smart TV penetration has increased, particularly in semi-urban and rural regions.
- Government PLI scheme is extending support to enhance domestic manufacturing of consumer durables electronics goods like air conditioners, LED lights.
- Heavy reliance on imports for components exposes the business to geopolitical risk and fluctuating trade policies affecting supply stability and cost structures.
- Rapid technological advancements in mobiles and electronics require continuous adaptation; failure to keep up could make offerings less attractive.
- Changes in consumer taste and preferences, such as increased demand for online shopping or preference for new brands, could impact the Company's traditional retail model.
